case.title: 黑白极简编辑式作品集
case.author: shushant_l
case.summary: 黑白、大留白、强排版，作品/技能/评价/关于/联系，轻微动效；明确避免渐变和玻璃效果。
case.promptSourceText:
Here's how to create your personal portfolio website in Ultra Minimalist style

Use this prompt: Build a premium personal portfolio website in an ultra minimalism style with a clean black-and-white color palette only, using no gradients, no glassmorphism, and no decorative effects. Focus on extreme simplicity, generous whitespace, strong typography, precise alignment, and a sophisticated editorial aesthetic. Include a hero section with name, title, and short introduction, followed by selected projects, skills, testimonials, about section, and contact section. Use subtle micro-interactions, smooth scrolling, monochrome imagery, minimalist icons, and elegant hover states. Prioritize readability, visual hierarchy, and a luxury modern feel inspired by high-end design studios, with a fully responsive layout, fast loading performance, and a timeless, distraction-free user experience.

Note: Customise the prompt to your use case

I've built this with Replit, and you can also build with it, or else you can also build it with any other AI model, LLM, or AI website generation tool
